title: Jack Henry Plans Google Cloud Ledger Integration for Tokenized Deposits
why_it_matters: Connecting deposit services to a bank's operating systems addresses an adoption barrier: institutions need usable integration alongside the underlying ledger technology.
caption:
RWA WIRE // INSTITUTIONS

Jack Henry Plans Google Cloud Ledger Integration for Tokenized Deposits

The planned connection would give community banks and credit unions access to programmable payment infrastructure through their existing core technology provider.
